projectTitle: AI-Driven Real-Time Traffic Management & Congestion Routing
abstractText: This project leverages computer vision and deep learning to dynamically adjust traffic signal timers based on vehicle density, reducing average commute delay by 35%.
literatureSurveyText: Surveyed IEEE 2023 paper on YOLOv8 vehicle detection and smart signal algorithms (Smith et al., 2023). Existing systems rely on fixed timers causing unnecessary wait times.
